create_evoformer_module: create an Evoformer Haiku module with config and global_config to generate single and pair embeddings
run_evoformer_call: run the Evoformer __call__ method with a batch, prev state, target features, and key to get embeddings
build_seq_pair_embedding: build a pair embedding from sequence features using _seq_pair_embedding with token features and target features
embed_template_pair: embed template structures into pair activations using _embed_template_pair with batch, pair activations, mask, and key
process_msa_stack: process MSA data through the Evoformer MSA stack using _embed_process_msa to update pair activations
